svg.title: A ten-minute crafting trial: timeline and tool calls
svg.desc: One trial on 2026-10-20, stopped at ten minutes. 33 LLM calls; 31 tool calls including 2 errors. The timeline shows all non-internal calls, grouped by role, with delegation intervals separate from their children. The final LLM call was aborted. Counts by tool: read_recipe: 7, 0 errors; find_nearest_blocks: 5, 1 errors; collect_resource: 4, 1 errors; craft_from_inventory_2x2: 2, 0 errors; get_dropped_items: 2, 0 errors; get_inventory: 2, 0 errors; search_recipes: 2, 0 errors; ask_planner: 1, 0 errors; equip: 1, 0 errors; get_block: 1, 0 errors; get_voxel_view: 1, 0 errors; place: 1, 0 errors; run_step: 1, 0 errors; submit_plan: 1, 0 errors. Neither pickaxe was present at the end.

g.text: LLM calls and tools · time since request acceptance
Very short calls appear as ticks. Internal operations are hidden.
Delegations contain other calls; their durations are not additive.
The final LLM request was aborted at the time limit.
Recorded calls · counts, not task success
Delegation tools are included. Internal operations are not.
LLM requests occupied 572.82 s of the 600 s trial, including the final aborted request.
The first collection error was a missing harvesting tool. Neither requested pickaxe was present at the end.
One recorded trial, not a benchmark. Source: campaign_1792497383278_f1e7505b
